name: Stillwater
tagline: A slower pace. A little closer to nature.
description: A quiet countryside retreat. Thoughtfully made spaces, seasonal food and time to yourself.

hero.heading: Somewhere to simply be.
hero.subheading: Wake slowly. Wander a little. Settle into a quieter rhythm at our small countryside retreat.
hero.mediaAlt: A secluded house surrounded by lush green trees

services.heading: Stay a little. Feel a world away.

items.title: Restful rooms
items.description: Natural textures, soft linen and a view worth waking up for. Thoughtful spaces for long mornings and early nights.

items.title: Food with a sense of place
items.description: Seasonal plates, local ingredients and a table to gather around. Simple food, made with care.

items.title: Your kind of outdoors
items.description: Follow a woodland path, find a quiet corner with a book, or set out to explore the surrounding countryside.

services.intro: Thoughtful spaces, seasonal food and days that unfold at your own pace.

features.heading: Less on the agenda. More to enjoy.

items.title: Unhurried mornings
items.description: Coffee by the window. Breakfast when you’re ready. Time that feels like your own.

items.title: Room to reconnect
items.description: Shared tables and quiet corners. Space to be together, and space just for you.

items.title: Nature on your doorstep
items.description: Fresh air, leafy paths and the pleasure of having nowhere else to be.

gallery.heading: Find your favourite corner.
gallery.intro: Take your time. Explore the details.

items.question: How do I enquire about a stay?
items.answer: Send us your preferred dates, the number of guests and anything you would like us to know. We’ll reply with availability and the details of your stay.

items.question: Can you accommodate dietary needs?
items.answer: Tell us about your dietary needs when you enquire so we can confirm the options available before you book.

items.question: What should I bring?
items.answer: A good book, comfortable walking shoes and clothes for the season. We’ll include any other useful details in your booking confirmation.

cta.heading: A little time away does wonders.
cta.body: Tell us when you’d like to visit. We’ll take it from there.
